constructors.name: constructor
constructors.signature: (S: TopoDS_Shape, Radius: number, Tol: number, NUBS: boolean)
constructors.comment: : Shape to be rounded <Radius>: radius of the fillet <Tol>: Tol3d used in approximations <NUBS>: if true, generate only NUBS surfaces, if false, generate analytical surfaces if possible

instanceMethods.name: Init
instanceMethods.signature: (S: TopoDS_Shape, Radius: number, Tol: number, NUBS: boolean): void

instanceMethods.name: Clear
instanceMethods.comment: Clear all the Fields.

instanceMethods.name: SetFaces
instanceMethods.comment: Set two faces of <myShape> on which the Sphere must roll.

instanceMethods.name: SetEdge
instanceMethods.comment: Set an edge of <myShape> to be rounded.

instanceMethods.name: SetStoppingFace
instanceMethods.comment: Set a face on which the fillet must stop.

instanceMethods.name: Perform
instanceMethods.comment: Compute the generated surfaces. If <BuildShape> is true, compute the resulting Shape. If false, only the blending surfaces are computed.

instanceMethods.name: Shape
instanceMethods.comment: returns the result

instanceMethods.name: NbSurfaces
instanceMethods.comment: returns the Number of generated surfaces.

instanceMethods.name: Surface
instanceMethods.comment: returns the surface of range Index

instanceMethods.name: Surface
instanceMethods.comment:
returns the surface generated by the centerline. <CenterLine> may be
- an edge : generate a pipe.
- a vertex : generate a sphere. Warning: returns a Null Handle if <CenterLine> generates no surface.

instanceMethods.name: Face
instanceMethods.comment: returns the surface of range Index

instanceMethods.name: Face
instanceMethods.comment:
returns the face generated by the centerline. <CenterLine> may be
- an edge : generate a pipe.
- a vertex : generate a sphere. Warning: returns a Null Shape if <CenterLine> generates no surface.

instanceMethods.name: CenterLines
instanceMethods.comment:
set in <LC> all the center lines
@param LC Mutated in place; read the updated value from this argument after the call.

instanceMethods.name: ContactType
instanceMethods.comment: returns the type of contact

instanceMethods.name: SupportShape1
instanceMethods.comment: gives the first support shape relative to SurfaceFillet(Index);

instanceMethods.name: SupportShape2
instanceMethods.comment: gives the second support shape relative to SurfaceFillet(Index);

instanceMethods.name: CurveOnShape1
instanceMethods.comment: gives the 3d curve of SurfaceFillet(Index) on SupportShape1(Index)

instanceMethods.name: CurveOnShape2
instanceMethods.comment: gives the 3d curve of SurfaceFillet(Index) on SupportShape2(Index)

instanceMethods.name: PCurveOnFace1
instanceMethods.comment: gives the PCurve associated to CurvOnShape1(Index) on the support face Warning: returns a Null Handle if SupportShape1 is not a Face

instanceMethods.name: PCurve1OnFillet
instanceMethods.comment: gives the PCurve associated to CurveOnShape1(Index) on the Fillet

instanceMethods.name: PCurveOnFace2
instanceMethods.comment: gives the PCurve associated to CurveOnShape2(Index) on the support face Warning: returns a Null Handle if SupportShape2 is not a Face

instanceMethods.name: PCurve2OnFillet
instanceMethods.comment: gives the PCurve associated to CurveOnShape2(Index) on the fillet

instanceMethods.name: IndicesOfBranche
instanceMethods.signature: (Index: number, From: number, To: number): { From: number; To: number }
instanceMethods.comment:
Set in <From>,<To> the indices of the faces of the branche <Index>.
i.e: Branche<Index> = Face(From) + Face(From+1) + ..+ Face(To)
@returns A result object with fields:
- `From`: updated value from the call.
- `To`: updated value from the call.

instanceMethods.name: ComputeCenters
instanceMethods.comment: Computes the center lines.

classes.name: BiTgte_CurveOnEdge
classes.summary: private class used to create a filler rolling on an edge.

instanceMethods.name: ShallowCopy
instanceMethods.comment: Shallow copy of adaptor.

instanceMethods.name: NbIntervals
instanceMethods.comment: Returns the number of intervals for continuity . May be one if Continuity(me) >= .

instanceMethods.name: Intervals
Trim
instanceMethods.signature: (First: number, Last: number, Tol: number): Adaptor3d_Curve
instanceMethods.comment: Returns a curve equivalent of <me> between parameters <First> and <Last>. <Tol> is used to test for 3d points confusion. If <First> >= <Last>.

instanceMethods.name: EvalD0
instanceMethods.comment: Computes the point of parameter theU on the curve.

instanceMethods.name: EvalD1
instanceMethods.comment: Computes the point and first derivative at parameter theU.

instanceMethods.name: EvalD2
instanceMethods.comment: Computes the point and first two derivatives at parameter theU.

instanceMethods.name: EvalD3
instanceMethods.comment: Computes the point and first three derivatives at parameter theU.

instanceMethods.name: EvalDN
instanceMethods.comment: Returns the derivative of order theN at parameter theU.

instanceMethods.name: Resolution
instanceMethods.comment: Returns the parametric resolution corresponding to the real space resolution <R3d>.

instanceMethods.name: GetType
instanceMethods.comment: Returns the type of the curve in the current interval: Line, Circle, Ellipse, Hyperbola, Parabola, BezierCurve, BSplineCurve, OtherCurve.
